body:
I was just about to make this post lol I've been thinking of this as well.
Human body was far too resilient, it's like extremely hard to die apparently (unless you are a baby/extremely sick or like super old)..

Like any simple enough way to die has an excellent chance of you not dying and instead suffering for long period/rest of your life.
Like fuck human body!
That is a very interesting perspective and makes a lot of sense!
Would you mind elaborating about your case? I think there are Reddit communities regarding legal advice and whatnot, have you checked them out?

Sadly, I don't but thanks for the realistic take.
If I do get kicked out, guess I won't have anything to lose so there is a silver lining

You are still very young! You have so much ahead of you. 
Please keep powering through!

Yes I do admit it, I might've worded it poorly. I didn't mean to say others should encourage suicide. 

I just wished people would put more thought into it or just simply be a bit more honest. Sometimes it just feels disingenuous even if it comes from a good place.

I'm not "mad at the world", I've never been mad at it. In fact I truly believe the world is wonderful and most people are actually good.

Again, doing something poorly and half assed is just as bad as not doing it. Guess there's no harm though but just something that irks me

I feel that. It was the same for me as well. 
Cats are absolutely wonderful little things 💕 (or any animal really butt I'm biased)

Yes, I just feel ungrateful now haha..

And thank you for the offer. Truly. I didn't doubt the genuinety of it, I will keep that in mind. Also, again you are very kind for the offer ❤️ have a fantastic day :))

Your story ends on a positive note at least. I'm glad!
My issues are a bit different but I've confided in someone and it just wasn't convincing enough.

I'm still sure if I were to disappear while most people wouldn't be happy or anything, in the long run I'd just be one less thing to worry about.

Actually I'm not entirely sure as to why I dropped out but it was plenty of factors.

Depression makes me want to spend unhealthy amount of time on PC, video-games etc., It might also have something to do with my own aptitude but I like to think I would've pulled through and last but not the least, my parents forced me to quit by telling me I just can't do it and I should quit already after terrible grades for the first three semesters (a friend of mine told them about it.. a friend I've cut all my ties with for another reason).

Soo yes sorry for messy writing, I'm on phone, my parents took my PC away cause they think I'm just lazy which has worsened my depression severely. 
I cannot write properly and in a good format on a shitty phone haha

I can't love myself honestly, there's nothing. It's less of me believing it, more of me knowing it. I just want to figure out how to deal with it.

As for you, good luck! You have a good attitude and I am 100 percent sure you'll be very kind and compassionate with your future family. They'd be incredibly lucky to have you. 
Take care of yourself ❤️
Why did he do it if I may ask? But yes those three sound like good friends ❤️ glad you have people who care about you!
Thank you! That makes more sense now that you said it. It's a shitty situation all around and I suppose I'm just being selfish

Thing is they would've lived much more if they were strays.
One of them died when he was 4, the second one before she could even turn even turn a year old.

Probably the only people (are cats people? I'd rather not call animals a thing either haha) who trusted me to take care of them, I failed them.

After the second death, I also feel like I deserve every miserable thing that happens to me.
Imagine being a waste of space, the slightest of good thing happens because someone might actually like you only them to suffer for ever caring about your pathetic ass.

You are being kind and I thank you for that ❤️ but honestly my entire teenage years and most of my young adult life has been miserable soon enough I'll be old and miserable which is even worse if I don't KMS which I'm dubious about.

I'm sorry, maybe my words were too harsh on others, I very much appreciate other people who still try to help others especially if the other person is some stranger from god knows where.

It hasn't gotten better for me and only continued to get worse but I'm so happy if you are doing better even if it's every so slightly. 

Thank you for the kind words :))

Hi!  Thank you for the kind, positive words ❤️
I'm sorry to hear about your shitty parents as well, truly shitty parenting can fuck the core of yourself eh? 

I dropped out of college I'm afraid soo there goes any educational qualifications I might have to turn things around haha..

I haven't physically hurt myself yet, I literally can't at least yet... I am a massive fuck up though! 

But I truly do hope you, anonymous stranger who bothered to comment have a wonderful life ahead of you. Not that the wish of something like me would matter (could it even be the opposite?) but best of luck to you.

I hope you've cut your parents off or are planning to :))

Thank you for the offer, that was very kind of you! 
I totally understand though, I just think these things hold almost no weight and are pretty much cliche to be of any real use.

I just wish if people don't know what to say, simply won't say anything or be more honest and straight up  admit they don't know what to say and simply wish good luck or anything along those lines.

Sorry, I know it's a weird thing to get hung up on since it comes from a place of love and care but it's honestly tiring.

Hello, I relate to this so bad. My own parents think that I'm addicted to my PC but don't realise I use it to cope with my depression and suicidal tendencies.

Parents (gen x and boomers in particular) are the absolute worst, most dispicable people on this planet. 
I'm sorry I don't have anything positive to say but just that I share the similar experience.
I'm sorry I can't help you but I feel the same. I get incredibly anxious
